notes:
Account background: product analytics SaaS for mid-market customers (B2B). Started as hosted API evaluation in Nov 2025; good adoption in staging but want dedicated for predictable throughput and tenancy isolation. Key stakeholders: VP Product (A. Flores), Head of Platform (M. Reed), Security (K. Alvarez).

Engagement summary: demo + throughput run on hosted API 2025-11-30 — showed 95th percentile latency ~120ms for short chat flows (hosted). They flagged token cost and need for consistent tail latency during peak batch jobs. Dec -> Jan pricing conversations, asked for committed capacity pricing and instance sizing guidance.

POC decision: moving to Dedicated POC to validate autoscaling, canary rollouts, and fallback routing. Ask: canary + rollback plan, model-variant routing (gpt-like large -> quantized L model fallback), region failover between us-west and eu-west, and clear SLOs for 99.9% availability.

Technical requirements noted: prefix KV caching for chat sessions, automated batching for embeddings pipelines, ability to pin model versions per route, per-route telemetry and token-level cost breakdowns. VPC peering required; want KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Data residency: primary data stays in US region with optional EU read-only replicas.

POC plan (agreed): 4-week Dedicated POC — week 0: infra setup & network peering; week 1: baseline workload replay from staging; week 2: canary rollout (10% traffic) of optimized quantized variant + observability tuning; week 3: scale to 50% with region failover tests; week 4: finalize cost/perf report and rollback/rollback playbook verification.

Quotes / signals: "We need repeatable tail latency at scale — if Dedicated can't hit that we won't commit." — Head of Platform. "Cost delta vs hosted must be predictably lower for embeddings-heavy pipelines." — VP Product.

Risks / open items: procurement wants a 12-month committed ARR number for finance; security wants clarifications on KMS key lifecycle and audit retention window; network team needs a schedule for peering that avoids their end-of-quarter freeze.

Next practical steps: schedule peering kickoff (blocked until network availability confirmed), share Dedicated POC runbook and canary playbook, finalize pricing addendum for committed capacity. SE (Ravi) to run canary workshop Wed 2026-03-10.
